title: Fylgja stage blocks — 014
description: The three stage blocks of the findings document, referenced from findings.schema.json by this $id: `resolved`, the reference one stage resolves to (the `stage` block on twin.create, twin.create --dry-run, intent.read with --stage and twin.step once its target resolved); `list`, stage.list's `stages` block; `plan`, stage.plan's `plan` block, whose steps are step.Diff's result. Replaces waypoints.schema.json (M10, M11): a stage is a moment of a proposed change (D-045), named <branch>/<label>, with two derived stages, branch-point and head, beside the operator's marks. Every fact the text prints and no more: artifacts by name and checksum, bootstraps as changed or not, never a line of either (Constitution X). Every list is sorted, so the same input gives the same document.

ref.description: <branch>/<label>: the reference syntax; branch-point and head name the derived stages

at_source.description: given: as_of was written on the mark and is used verbatim. written: the mark carries none, and the at is its own write stamp (label.updated_at). branch_point: the branch's branched_from, read on main. head: the latest stamp across the branch's intent and artifact checksums plus one microsecond

proposed_change.description: the proposed change the stage belongs to, found by its source branch among the open ones

resolved.description: One stage resolved to a pinned intent reference. The at is verbatim: what was written, what Infrahub returned, or the first instant after what it returned (the head). branch is the branch the read is on: main for the branch point, the proposed change's source branch otherwise

description.description: as the operator wrote it; empty when none was written, and for a derived stage

row.description: a resolved stage (the fields of `resolved`, restated because that schema admits nothing else) plus twin. Every stage has its row: one nothing names an at for (stage.at.unresolved, or stage.unknown for a source branch deleted under its open proposed change) has no at

twin.description: true on the one row the host's record names (twin.json 6's stage, by proposed change id and label); stage.twin.moved beside it says when that row no longer resolves to what the record holds

record.description: what twin.json under the state root names, as recorded, when it is readable and names a stage; the at and branch are the record's provenance, which the row's may since differ from (stage.twin.moved)

towards.description: the target of a diverged step, when state is diverged; null otherwise

orphan.description: a stage its proposed change no longer names, removed from its fylgja_stages (D-047): listed, warned (stage.orphaned), never planned or created from

list.description: stage.list: every stage of every open proposed change (or of the one whose source branch was asked for), sorted by branch then order (branch point, marks by at, head), each with the reference it resolves to; the orphaned stages; and the stage the host's readable record names, when it names one

branch.description: the --branch filter, or null when every open proposed change was listed

read_counts.description: intent read's summary line, as numbers: what the read holds and what the packages' profiles make of it

port.description: containerlab's port name, as the manifest's links carry it

step.description: step.Diff between two consecutive stages' bundles: a pure function of the two, with provenance excluded. unchanged is every list empty; the two ids are never equal between two stages, because at is hashed, and the step from a mark written after the last regenerate to the head is unchanged

computed.description: false when either stage did not compile; not_computed then names it, and nothing else is present

unchanged.description: nodes, links, bootstraps and artifacts identical; the bundles differ in provenance alone

reasons.description: sorted; bootstrap means the node's bootstrap file's bytes differ, and no line of it is quoted

changed.description: nodes present on both sides whose artifact checksum differs; an added or removed node's artifact goes with the node

plan_stage.description: one stage of a plan: its reference, label, description and where its at comes from in every case; branch and at once it resolved; the bundle when the compile did; the read counts when the read did; and its findings. A stage refused at resolution carries ref, label, description, at_source and findings alone, with bundle_id and read null

bundle_id.description: null when the stage was refused at resolution, read or compile

findings.description: this stage's findings, each also in the document's own list with the same rule, object, step and message

plan.description: stage.plan: the proposed change named by its source branch, each of its stages in order (branch point, marks by at, head) with what it resolved to, compiled to and read, or its findings; and the step between each consecutive pair

steps.description: one fewer than the stages, in order
